pred_ddx.label: Tricuspid Atresia with Ventricular Septal Defect and Patent Ductus Arteriosus or Double Outlet Right Ventricle
Double Outlet Right Ventricle with Subpulmonary Ventricular Septal Defect

Tricuspid Atresia with Ventricular Septa: The presence of a grade IV/VI right apical systolic murmur, severe dilation of the right atrium and right ventricle, a hypoplastic left ventricle, interatrial and interventricular defects, and two great vessels arising from the right ventricle suggest a complex congenital heart defect. The severe tricuspid regurgitation and bidirectional shunting at both septal defects further support this diagnosis.
